ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence مَا اسْمُكِ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am a pupil (girl).
   B. I am a pupil (boy).
   C. What is your name? (to a girl)
   D. My name is Ahmad.

2. How is the Arabic word اسْمِي read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. anaa bi-khayr
   B. ismii
   C. wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam
   D. sabaahu n-nuur

3. Which Arabic word means "goodbye"? (1 mark)
   A. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   B. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   C. مَرْحَبًا
   D. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ

4. How is the Arabic word كِتَابٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. naafidha
   B. qalam
   C. kitaab
   D. misbaah

5. What does the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cat
   B. pen
   C. table
   D. chair

6. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا بَيْتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my house.
   B. The cat is under the bed.
   C. The lamp is above the table.
   D. The book is on the table.

7. Which Arabic word means "read"? (1 mark)
   A. ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ
   B. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   C. اِقْرَأْ
   D. اُخْرُجْ

8. How is the Arabic word الْخَمِيسُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-ahad
   B. amsi
   C. as-sabt
   D. al-khamiis

9. How is the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. uktub
   B. iftahi l-baab
   C. ukhruj
   D. aghliqi l-baab

10. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like bananas.
   B. I like juice.
   C. I drink water.
   D. I eat bread.

11. What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat bread.
   B. I drink water.
   C. I like bananas.
   D. I like juice.

12. What does the Arabic sentence أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I see with my eye.
   B. I hear with my ear.
   C. I speak with my mouth.
   D. I smell with my nose.

13. Which Arabic sentence asks 'How is the weather today?' (1 mark)
   A. maa ismuka?
   B. kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
   C. hal tuhibbu l-mawz?
   D. ayna l-kitaab?

14. How do you read the syllable بِ? (1 mark)
   A. bi
   B. tu
   C. bii
   D. nu

15. How do you read the syllable تِ? (1 mark)
   A. laa
   B. ti
   C. si
   D. nii

16. Which sound does the Arabic letter ب make? (1 mark)
   A. k as in kite
   B. th as in think
   C. b as in bag
   D. a quick rolled r

17. What does the Arabic word سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) mean? (1 mark)
   A. window
   B. cup
   C. door
   D. knife

18. How is the Arabic word نَعَمْ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. baaluun
   B. hafla
   C. mabruuk
   D. naʿam

19. What does as-samaku ladhiidh mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like fish.
   B. Where is the fish?
   C. The fish is cold.
   D. The fish is delicious.

20. How is the Arabic word حَارٌّ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shams
   B. haarr
   C. matar
   D. shajara

21. When reciting a poem, what should your actions do? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a friend's actions
   B. Hide the words
   C. Show something different from the words
   D. Match the meaning of the words

22. Which sound does the Arabic letter ج make? (1 mark)
   A. f as in fan
   B. s as in sun
   C. a quick rolled r
   D. j as in jug

23. Which sound does the Arabic letter ت make? (1 mark)
   A. a quick rolled r
   B. t as in tap
   C. d as in dog
   D. m as in mat

24. Which letter completes the word _َمٌ to make fam (mouth)? (1 mark)
   A. ك (kaaf)
   B. ف (faa)
   C. ق (qaaf)
   D. م (miim)

25. What does the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bag
   B. kitchen
   C. door
   D. key

26. Which Arabic word means "tomorrow"? (1 mark)
   A. غَدًا
   B. الْيَوْمَ
   C. الْخَمِيسُ
   D. مَدْرَسَةٌ

27. Which day ends with taa marbuta (ة)? (1 mark)
   A. as-sabt
   B. al-khamiis
   C. al-jumuʿa
   D. al-ahad

28. What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The banana is delicious.
   B. This is my hand.
   C. I eat rice.
   D. I drink tea.

29. What does the Arabic sentence أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. My head is big.
   B. My hand is small.
   C. I clean my teeth.
   D. I wash my face.

30. Which sentence is the best beginning of a paragraph about your house? (1 mark)
   A. haadhaa baytii
   B. al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila
   C. uhibbu baytii
   D. fii l-matbakhi taawila

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Put these letters in order to make a day: ت ب س. Write the word and its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Write three foods and two drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

33. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila (2 marks)

34. Explain how drawing and labelling help you to remember new words. (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into English: azraʿu shajara (2 marks)

36. List the members of the nuclear family in Arabic (English letters) with their meanings. Give at least four. (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into English: aghsilu wajhii (2 marks)

38. Write four lines of a short conversation in which two friends greet each other and ask names. Use English letters for the Arabic. (4 marks) (4 marks)

39. Explain how a spelling bee is played. (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Write five household items in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

41. Translate into English: ashrabu sh-shaaya (2 marks)

42. Copy and translate the sentence أُحِبُّ الْخُبْزَ. (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Write two Arabic sentences in sounds about a celebration and translate them. (4 marks) (4 marks)

44. Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'Today is Thursday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Explain what makes a paragraph coherent. (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Give two reasons why we should take care of household items. (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Give three points you would check when you assess a friend's reading. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — What is your name? (to a girl)
   مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

2. B — ismii
   اسْمِي is read ismii and means my name is.

3. A — مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

4. C — kitaab
   كِتَابٌ is read kitaab and means book.

5. C — table
   طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) means table.

6. A — This is my house.
   هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

7. C — اِقْرَأْ
   اِقْرَأْ (iqraʾ) means read.

8. D — al-khamiis
   الْخَمِيسُ is read al-khamiis and means Thursday.

9. C — ukhruj
   اُخْرُجْ is read ukhruj and means go out.

10. B — I like juice.
   أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ (uhibbu l-ʿasiira) means: I like juice.

11. A — I eat bread.
   آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

12. D — I smell with my nose.
   أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي (ashummu bi-anfii) means: I smell with my nose.

13. B — kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
   kayfa means how, al-jawwu is the weather and al-yawm is today.

14. A — bi
   بِ is read bi.

15. B — ti
   تِ is read ti.

16. C — b as in bag
   The letter ب makes the sound b as in bag.

17. D — knife
   سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) means knife.

18. D — naʿam
   نَعَمْ is read naʿam and means yes.

19. D — The fish is delicious.
   samak is fish and ladhiidh means delicious.

20. B — haarr
   حَارٌّ is read haarr and means hot.

21. D — Match the meaning of the words
   Actions must match the words to help the audience understand.

22. D — j as in jug
   The letter ج makes the sound j as in jug.

23. B — t as in tap
   The letter ت makes the sound t as in tap.

24. B — ف (faa)
   The word fam (فَمٌ) starts with faa, which has one dot above.

25. B — kitchen
   مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) means kitchen.

26. A — غَدًا
   غَدًا (ghadan) means tomorrow.

27. C — al-jumuʿa
   الجمعة ends with ة.

28. C — I eat rice.
   آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

29. C — I clean my teeth.
   أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

30. A — haadhaa baytii
   haadhaa baytii (This is my house) introduces the topic.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: سبت (sabt), Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), samak (fish), mawz (bananas), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: The picture shows the meaning and writing the label practises the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: I plant a tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), ibn (son), bint (daughter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 4.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: I wash my face.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: A: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. B: wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam. A: maa ismuka? B: ismii Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line: greeting, reply, question, answer.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Teams take turns; a learner says the Arabic word and spells it by naming the letters; correct spelling earns a point.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for teams, 1 mark for spelling by letter names and 1 mark for scoring.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: uhibbu l-khubza. I like bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct copy or sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example haadhihi hafla. This is a party. ʿindii hadiyya. I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each translation.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis. Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sentences are about one topic and are in a good order, so they fit together and make sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for one topic and 1 mark for a logical order.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: They last longer and save money, and keeping them in the right place keeps us safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words pronounced correctly; smooth reading without stops; heavy and throat sounds clear; no word skipped.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: The book is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
